subject: Acme POC: success criteria & access provisioning
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 10:22:00 -0500
Subject: Acme POC: success criteria & access provisioning

Hi Samir —

Great to connect today — thanks for the time. Per our discovery, attached is a short POC plan and a proposed set of success criteria so your team and ours have alignment before we hand over credentials. Key items we discussed: 

- Success criteria (minimal): latency < 300ms median on 512-token requests, >95% relevance on the supplied eval prompts, and stable throughput for 50 concurrent sessions.
- Timeline: 2-week technical POC starting once access is provisioned, followed by a 1-week evaluation window.
- Ownership: Acme technical lead to validate eval set and provide SSO/IP allowlist; Redwood to provision API keys and assist with model/config tuning.

Next steps I propose:
1) Please confirm the Acme success criteria (attached spreadsheet) or send edits.
2) Send the IP allowlist CIDRs and SAML metadata (or designate that you prefer API key + IP allowlist).
3) Confirm the Acme technical point-of-contact for provisioning (name/email).

I've attached the access instructions and the success criteria spreadsheet for easy reference. Once we have the allowlist and SSO metadata we will:
- Create a scoped API key for the POC
- Issue SSO invite to the Acme test users you list
- Share a pre-configured eval plan and kickoff meeting invite

If that all sounds good, I'll block time for a short kickoff the week of Mar 2.

Thanks,
Marissa
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: acme-poc-access-instructions.pdf
Attachment: acme-poc-success-criteria.xlsx

- Confirmed success criteria: latency target and eval pass-rate look fine; we'll add a business KPI around summary accuracy for our internal documents (see notes in the attached).
- For access: we'll do SSO + IP allowlist. Our security team prefers SAML SSO for the test users and will provide metadata. I'll also send the allowlist CIDRs (we're a single cloud region for the POC).
- Technical POC owner: Tony Lee (tony.lee@acme.com) — he's looped below and will coordinate IP allowlist and SSO metadata.

Can you confirm how long after we provide the SAML metadata + IP CIDRs you can issue the API key and send SSO invites? Also, any steps Tony should follow to validate the SSO connection on his side?

Thanks,

   - Send SSO invites to test users you list and provide a short SAML test checklist
3) We'll schedule a 30-min kickoff to walk through the eval plan and test users. Proposed window: Tue Mar 9 or Wed Mar 10.
